description.value: Ramen Arashi is a Japanese ramen franchise founded in Banff in 2017 by Ken Seki and Yuji Yokomori, dedicated to bringing authentic regional ramen styles to Canada without trendy twists. The Victoria location opened in 2022 as the brand's first franchise and has been described as Victoria's best-rated ramen shop on Google, with features on the popular YouTube channel Abroad in Japan. Touring cyclists looking for a warm, sit-down restorative meal will find a focused ramen menu in a busy Douglas Street retail strip.
